Each tile has a designated position, and players must use their problem-solving skills to move the tiles into their correct positions. sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks
sections.body:

* Start with the easy levels and gradually move on to the more challenging ones.
* Use the 'Hint' feature to get a nudge in the right direction.

* Don't be afraid to experiment and try different strategies.

By following these tips and tricks, you'll be well on your way to becoming a puzzle-solving master. Remember, practice makes perfect, so don't get discouraged if you don't solve the puzzles right away. sections.heading: Advanced Strategies
sections.body:
Once you've mastered the beginner levels, it's time to take your puzzle-solving skills to the next level. Here are some advanced strategies to help you conquer even the most challenging levels:

* Use the 'Rotate' feature to rotate the tiles and create new combinations.
* Look for patterns and symmetries in the puzzle to help you solve it more efficiently.
* Don't be afraid to think outside the box and try unconventional strategies.
